# Documentation

MaaFramework Go binding `1.7.0` at `e413b08e148bd3e1fb1193f3df03ff304ac8150f`.

- **MaaFramework Golang Binding**: This is the Go binding for MaaFramework, providing Go developers with a simple and effective way to use MaaFramework's features within their Go applications. [`README.md`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/maa-framework-go/blob/e413b08e148bd3e1fb1193f3df03ff304ac8150f/README.md)
- **MaaFramework Golang 绑定**: 这是 MaaFramework 的Go语言绑定，为Go开发者提供了一种简单而有效的方式，在他们的Go应用程序中使用MaaFramework的功能。 [`README_zh.md`](https://github.com/MaaXYZ/maa-framework-go/blob/e413b08e148bd3e1fb1193f3df03ff304ac8150f/README_zh.md)
